info.name: QuickBite API v1 (Complete)
info.description: Complete Postman API Collection for QuickBite Backend (147 REST APIs + 2 Actuator Probes across 36 Controllers and 14 Bounded Contexts). Uses `{{base_url}}` (default `http://localhost:8080`) and automatically routes JWT role tokens (`customer_token`, `owner_token`, `agent_token`, `admin_token`, `challenge_token`).
